entries.en: Look, I don't like it when someone stares at me!
entries.ro: Uite, nu-mi place când cineva se uită la mine!

entries.en: Look, choom, go back to where you came from!
entries.ro: Uite, choom, întoarce-te de unde ai venit!

entries.en: What do you want…? No… That it?
No… I won't lend it to you because it's my fucking car, that's why…
entries.ro: Nu… Nu ți-o împrumut pentru că e mașina mea nenorocită, de-aia…

entries.en: Nah, if you're gonna shoot, just shoot. I don't care.
entries.ro: Nah, dacă vrei să tragi, trage. Nu-mi pasă.

entries.en: Fine… I said, fine…! No! I don't want to!
entries.ro: Bine… Am zis bine…! Nu! Nu vreau!

entries.en: What's done is done, you know… Kiss my ass.
entries.ro: Ce-a fost a fost, știi… Pupă-mă-n cur!

entries.en: Hey! You're just gonna walk away from me?
entries.ro: Hei! Doar o să pleci de lângă mine?

entries.en: Mm-hm. I knew you'd be back.
